objective: Frozen-rule transfer from HG005 development to HG001 on a newly hash-selected chr20 panel, with exact local support and no recalibration from HG001 outcomes.
flowcell_selection: Lexicographically first listed HG001 SUP flowcell before outcome inspection; no performance-based selection.
selection: Use frozen HG002 candidate chr20 catalog from MP36 archive. PASS or dot simple biallelic ACGT indels2-30nt, shorter allele1nt; exact reference,500bp confident flanks, isolated HG001 truth context. Positive exact homozygous-alt PASS/dot allele; negative absent overlapping truth record. Heterozygous/complex/representation-conflicted contexts excluded before observations. Exclude all128 MP36 calibration/test positions. Buffer100kb around1Mb boundaries. One lowest SHA256(MP38_LOCUS|chr20|pos|ref|alt) per100kb bin regardless label, then first32 per label by hash. Require32 per class without relaxation, otherwise INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_LOCI. Preserve full exclusions. No new calibration partition or fitting.
source_admission: Verify sample identity and acquisition date from public flowcell metadata; CRAM chr20 length/M5 must match archived exact reference. Preserve original index and derive/check any header shift, never assume -186. Bind source bytes/ETag and benchmark subset before scoring.
reads: As MP37: at most20 hash-ranked eligible primary MAPQ20 reads with actual nested150/300nt observations; minimum10; no locus replacement. Exclude all MP36 retained IDs and report cross-cohort overlap.
rules: Transport unchanged median relative cutoff0, strict>=80% read consensus cutoff0, prior consensus cutoff4, and median0 with>=80% absolute guard. Absolute thresholds59/118. No use of benchmark labels in scores or parameter fitting.
primary: At300nt, separate descriptive transfer gates for median0 and consensus0: more concordant calls than consensus4, no more discordant calls, concordance>=95% of64 planned loci, no development-ID overlap. Report all local failures; no claim of conditional coverage or population accuracy.
local_reporting: All loci, source observations, size2-4/5-10/11-30, genotype class, insertion/deletion,1Mb region, orientation, support and nested set memberships. Paired method and context transitions. No outcome-adaptive strata.
limitations: New individual, acquisition and selected targets, but one flowcell and same platform/laboratory pipeline. Targeted balanced isolated homozygotes, not heterozygous or de-novo discovery accuracy. No same-fragment editing truth. Independence of all upstream benchmark/preprocessing choices is not established.
runtime: CPU Colab CLI,8-locus checkpoints persisted per batch,24h maximum. Independent distances and second source extraction before closure. No alteration of MP36/MP37 outcomes.
